title: Free time
goal: Talk about hobbies, plans and wishes with verbal nouns, and follow a short text about someone's free time.

intro.text: Put the unit together: what you like doing (*resim yapmayı seviyorum*), what you're thinking of doing (*taşınmayı düşünüyorum*), what you'd like others to do (*gelmeni isterim*) and where you're off to (*yüzmeye gidiyorum*).

vocab.en: to be interested (in: -lA); to take care of
to collect, to gather; to tidy up

exercises.title: Ece'nin boş zamanı
exercises.passage:
Ece otuz yaşında ve bir bankada çalışıyor. İşini seviyor, ama boş zamanlarında başka şeylerle ilgilenmekten hoşlanıyor. Geçen yıl bir resim kursuna başladı. Artık her cumartesi sabahı resim yapıyor. Pazar günleri de arkadaşlarıyla yürüyüşe çıkıyor.

Ece'nin bir hobisi daha var: eski kartpostal toplamak. Şimdi yüzden fazla kartpostalı var.

Annesi onun daha çok dinlenmesini istiyor: “Bu kadar çok şeye nasıl vakit buluyorsun?” Ece gülüyor: “Resim yaparken dinleniyorum, anne. Yürüyüş de bana iyi geliyor.”
exercises.translation: Ece is thirty and works at a bank. She likes her job, but in her free time she enjoys taking an interest in other things. Last year she started a painting class. Now she paints every Saturday morning. And on Sundays she goes out walking with her friends. Ece has one more hobby: collecting old postcards. She now has more than a hundred postcards. Her mother wants her to rest more: “How do you find time for so many things?” Ece laughs: “I rest while I paint, Mom. And walking does me good.”

questions.q: What did Ece start last year?
options: A new job at a bank
questions.explain: *Geçen yıl bir resim kursuna başladı*: *başlamak* takes the dative, *kursuna*.
*Onun daha çok dinlenmesini istiyor*: `-mA` + possessive, **she wants her to rest more**.

questions.q: How does Ece answer her mother?
options: She wants to quit the class
questions.explain: *Resim yaparken dinleniyorum*: **I rest while I paint**.

exercises.question: What does Can ask of Elif?

context.en: What are you thinking of doing at the weekend?
I don't know. Maybe I'll go swimming. You?

context.tr: Ben dağa yürüyüşe çıkmak istiyorum. Senin de gelmeni çok isterim.
context.en: I want to go hiking in the mountains. I'd love you to come too.

context.tr: Olur, ama erken kalkmaktan nefret ederim.
context.en: All right, but I hate getting up early.

why.1: Swimming is Elif's idea: *Belki yüzmeye giderim*.
why.2: Getting up early is what Elif hates: *erken kalkmaktan nefret ederim*.

exercises.explain: *Senin de gelmeni çok isterim*: `-mA` + possessive, **I'd love you to come too**.

exercises.en: On weekends I love going out for walks.

reject.why: *Çıkmak* (to go out) takes the dative: *yürüyüşe çıkmak*.
Harmony: the last vowel of *çıkma* is a, so *-yı*.

exercises.explain: *yürüyüş-e çıkmak* (to go out for a walk), then *çıkma-y-ı*, the accusative that *sevmek* needs.

accept: My mother wants me to rest more.
My [mom|mum] wants me to rest more.
My [mother|mom|mum] wants me to get more rest.

exercises.tr: Resim yapmak benim için çok eğlenceli.
exercises.en: Painting is a lot of fun for me.

exercises.prompt: I would love you to come.

exercises.explain: *Bırakmak* (to quit) takes the accusative: *içmeyi bırakmak*. It is itself the bare infinitive that *istemek* needs.

exercises.gloss: to understand, as in trying to understand (… çalışıyorum)
exercises.explain: *-mAyA çalışmak* is **to try to**: the dative of the verbal noun, *anla-ma-y-a*.

exercises.en: We're thinking of moving to Turkey next year.

accept: We went hiking at the weekend.
We went [hiking|for a hike|for a walk] [on|over] the weekend.
We went [for a hike|for a walk] at the weekend.
[At|On|Over] the weekend we went [hiking|for a hike|for a walk].
We went [hiking|for a hike|for a walk] last weekend.
Last weekend we went [hiking|for a hike|for a walk].
